data.name: Paul
data.gender_notes: Paul is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin paulus, 'small, humble'. Its root is Latin paulus. Paul the Apostle, author of the New Testament epistles. Paul is a Latin name meaning “Small; humble”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Paul expresses “Small; humble”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Paul total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
